senses.gloss: (I)--A daughter of स्वायम्भुव Manu (Vai- राज-वा। प्।) and शतरूपा. Wife of Ruci. From her Hari manifested himself for imparting धर्म and ज्ञान। Gave birth to twins--a son and a daughter by पुत्रिकाधर्म। These were यज्ञ and दक्षिणा. भा. I. 3. १२; III. १२. ५५-56; IV. 1. 1-4; VIII. 1. 5; II. 7. 2; Br. III. 3. ११३; वा. १०. १७-9; Br. I. 1. ५८; II. 9. ४२-43; Vi. I. 7. १८-19. [page१-144+ २४]
(II)--the queen of Sarvatejas and mother of Manu चाक्षुष. भा. IV. १३. १५.
(VI)--became twins in the आकूति कल्प। वा. २१. ५५-56.
(VII)--a son of Brahman with a मन्त्रशरीर वा. ६७. 4-5.
(VIII)--the mother of यज्ञ, the mindborn son in the first epoch of Manu. Vi. III. 1. ३६.
(III)--the wife of पृथुसेन and mother of Nakta. भा. V. १५. 6.
